skill.name: python-fastapi
skill.description: Guides Python FastAPI development with uv, modular architecture, async SQLAlchemy, Alembic migrations, and pytest patterns.

security_audit.summary: Most code fence, dotenv, and SQLAlchemy session findings are false positives from documentation examples. Confirmed risks include remote installer execution, hardcoded placeholder secrets, broad Uvicorn binding, permissive CORS, and unauthenticated user endpoints. No prompt injection evidence was found.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly into a shell.
remediation.suggestion: Replace curl pipe-to-shell setup with package manager instructions, version pinning, and checksum verification steps.

remediation.issue: Database URL and secret key examples include hardcoded defaults.
remediation.suggestion: Require these values from environment variables and show safe placeholders without embedded credentials.

remediation.issue: User management routes do not show authentication or authorization checks.
remediation.suggestion: Add current-user dependencies, role checks, and ownership checks before returning or updating user records.

remediation.issue: CORS middleware allows wildcard origins with credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Use environment-specific allowed origins and avoid wildcard methods and headers in production examples.

remediation.issue: Run commands bind Uvicorn to all interfaces.
remediation.suggestion: Use 127.0.0.1 for local development and document reverse proxy, firewall, and TLS controls for production.

content.value_statement: FastAPI projects need consistent structure, database patterns, and test guidance. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code produce organized Python API work.
actual_capabilities: Defines a feature-based FastAPI project layout for Python services.
Shows uv setup commands for dependencies and development tooling.
Provides Pydantic settings and async SQLAlchemy session patterns.
Outlines repository, service, schema, model, and API layers.
Includes Alembic migration setup for async database engines.
Provides pytest, httpx, lint, format, and type-check workflow examples.
limitations: It is a reference guide, not a complete generated application.
Authentication and authorization patterns are not fully implemented.
Production examples require secret, CORS, and network hardening.
Commands assume Python 3.12 and uv are available.

use_cases.title: Start a New API Service
use_cases.description: Create a structured FastAPI project with uv, async database access, migrations, and tests.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Patterns
use_cases.description: Document common module boundaries for schemas, models, repositories, services, and routers.

use_cases.title: Add Database and Test Workflows
use_cases.description: Use the migration and async test examples to extend an existing FastAPI codebase.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Project Layout
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new API.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a FastAPI project layout using this skill. Include folders, key files, uv dependencies, and a short setup checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Feature Module
prompt_templates.scenario: Add one domain feature to an existing service.
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a products feature to my FastAPI app. Include schema, model, repository, service, router, and test guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Wire Async Database Migrations
prompt_templates.scenario: Connect SQLAlchemy and Alembic for async PostgreSQL.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my FastAPI database setup and propose async SQLAlchemy and Alembic changes that match this skill.

prompt_templates.title: Review Production Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this FastAPI service for production readiness. Focus on secrets, CORS, auth, migrations, tests, and run commands.

output_examples.input: Create a users feature for a FastAPI service.
output_examples.output: A feature plan covering schemas, model fields, repository methods, service responsibilities, API routes, and async tests.

output_examples.input: Prepare async database migrations for my API.
output_examples.output: A migration checklist with engine setup, metadata imports, revision creation, upgrade steps, and rollback considerations.

output_examples.input: Review my FastAPI service before deployment.
output_examples.output: A production review covering secret handling, CORS restrictions, host binding, authorization gaps, logging, and test coverage.

best_practices: Replace placeholder credentials and secret keys before deployment.
Keep feature modules small and separate routes, services, and data access.
Add authentication, authorization, and tests before exposing user data.
anti_patterns: Do not pipe remote installers directly into a shell.
Do not deploy wildcard CORS with credentialed requests.
Do not expose user management routes without permission checks.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build FastAPI services with modular Python structure, async database access, migrations, and tests.

faq.question: Does it generate a complete application?
faq.answer: No. It provides patterns and examples that an assistant can apply to your codebase.

faq.question: Which package manager does it use?
faq.answer: It uses uv for project setup, dependency management, and command execution examples.

faq.question: Does it include database guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers async SQLAlchemy sessions, PostgreSQL connection patterns, and Alembic migrations.

faq.question: Is it ready for production by default?
faq.answer: No. You must harden secrets, CORS, network binding, and authorization before production use.

faq.question: Can Claude Code and Codex use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
